description: We are The Build Club, a team of passionate builders interested in AI, software, SaaS, and problem-solving. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we aim to create an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that makes space exploration engaging and educational. We welcome curious minds with skills in AI/ML, web development, game development, UI/UX, astronomy, data analysis, and space science. Let's learn, build, and explore together!
